items.exampleEn: This old car has a large wooden steering wheel.
items.exampleZh: 這輛老車有一個大大的木製方向盤。

items.exampleEn: The sign was printed unclearly, so we missed our exit.
items.exampleZh: 標誌印得不清楚，所以我們錯過了出口。

items.exampleEn: The picture on the wall is hanging upside down.
The article gives a well-balanced view of both sides.
items.exampleZh: 這篇文章對雙方的看法呈現得很平衡。

items.exampleEn: The young boxer is tall and well-built.
items.exampleZh: 那位年輕拳擊手又高又壯。
items.glossZh: 體格健壯的；建造堅固的

items.exampleEn: Her desk is so well-organized that she can find anything in seconds.
items.exampleZh: 她的桌子整理得井然有序，任何東西幾秒內就找得到。
items.glossZh: 井然有序的；組織良好的

items.exampleEn: The runners were worn out after the long race.
items.exampleZh: 長跑比賽後，選手們都累壞了。
items.glossZh: 累壞的；破舊的（應寫 worn out）

items.sentenceEn: The map was upside down, so we walked the wrong way.
items.sentenceZh: 地圖拿反了，所以我們走錯了方向。

items.audioEn: The new library is well-organized; every book has a clear label and its own place.
items.audioZh: 新圖書館井然有序，每本書都有清楚的標籤和固定的位置。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得新圖書館怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: After the long hike, I felt completely worn out.
items.sentenceZh: 長途健行後，我覺得精疲力竭。

items.sentenceEn: Our team is well-balanced, with strong players in every position.
items.sentenceZh: 我們隊很均衡，每個位置都有強勁的球員。

items.stemEn: This ____ bookshelf can hold hundreds of heavy books.
items.stemZh: 這個做工堅固的書架可以放好幾百本重書。

items.stemEn: The singer sang the words so ____ that nobody knew what the song was about.
items.stemZh: 那位歌手把歌詞唱得很含糊，沒人知道這首歌在唱什麼。

items.passageEn: My sister started driving lessons last month. Her teacher is calm and well-organized, and every lesson has a clear plan. On the first day, she held the steering wheel so tightly that her hands hurt. Sometimes the teacher spoke unclearly while he looked down at his notes, so she had to ask him to repeat things. At busy intersections, she also had to watch out for every pedestrian. After two hours, she came home worn out but proud.
items.passageZh: 我的姊妹上個月開始上駕訓課。她的教練冷靜又有條理，每堂課都有清楚的計畫。第一天，她把方向盤握得太緊，手都痛了。教練有時低頭看筆記，說話不太清楚，她只好請他再說一遍。在車多的十字路口，她也得留意每一位行人。兩個小時後，她回到家累壞了，但很得意。

questions.questionZh: 第一天作者姊妹的手為什麼會痛？
為什麼教練說話有時不清楚？

items.promptZh: 這輛車的方向盤在右邊。
referenceEn: The steering wheel of this car is on the right.
This car has its steering wheel on the right side.
rubricZh: 要用 steering wheel（例如 the steering wheel of this car、its steering wheel 等）
「在右邊」可寫，例如 on the right、on the right side 等

items.promptZh: 這場音樂節辦得井然有序，每個節目都準時開始。
referenceEn: The music festival was well-organized, and every show started on time.
It was a well-organized music festival; every show began on time.
rubricZh: well-organized 當形容詞（例如 was well-organized、a well-organized festival 等）
「準時開始」可寫，例如 started on time、began on time 等
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 was、is 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：wornout 是非標準拼法（字典收 worn-out；述語位置寫 worn out）。單字卡、跟讀 q10 "felt completely wornout"、閱讀 "came home wornout" 都在教錯誤拼法。建議 lexicon 補 worn-out 並改寫（呼應自評疑慮 5）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/6 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案："I felt completely wornout" 述語位置標準寫法為 worn out（不加連字號）；跟讀題字幕會讓學習者學到錯誤拼法。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/9 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：疑似邏輯："the teacher sometimes spoke unclearly because of the traffic noise"——噪音讓人「聽不清楚」，不是讓教練「說得不清楚」，因果不順。建議改為 "it was hard to hear the teacher because of the traffic noise" 類寫法，或給 unclearly 別的原因（例如他低頭看筆記時說得不清楚）。
